headline: Black Forest Labs has released FLUX 3 Image Klein, a small open-weights image model that can run on an ordinary graphics card with 8 gigabytes of memory.
score_reason: Useful open release for home users, but rankings are the company's own internal testing and the report is short.
importance_line: Hobbyists and small studios can generate and edit images on consumer hardware, but the quality claims come only from the company and the licence limits free commercial use to firms earning under 5 million dollars a year.
summary: The Decoder reports that Black Forest Labs has released FLUX 3 Image Klein, a 5.6-billion-parameter open-weights model that creates and edits images and can run on an NVIDIA graphics card with 8 GB of memory, making an image in under 9 seconds on an RTX 4070. The company says its internal tests rank it highest among open models, and the weights are free for commercial use only by companies making under 5 million dollars a year.
